FS Mobile Toolkit

FS25 to FS26 mobile mod helper

Runs inside your phone browser. Your mod never leaves your phone. It converts the textures and settings, then checks the result. It cannot rework 3D models, so test every result in the game.

1. Choose your FS25 mod ZIP file(s)

No file chosen

2. Convert

The category and vehicle type names come from scanning the real FS26 mobile game. Pick one, or leave both empty to keep the mod's own. These two settings apply to every file in a batch, so leave them empty when the files are different kinds of things.

3. Check results

    4. Save the converted ZIP(s)

    Copy it to your game's mods folder and test. If something fails, send me the report above and the game's error message.

    Compare with a working mobile mod

      FS map inspector

      Reads a mod or map ZIP of any size right on your phone. Nothing is uploaded and no internet is needed. It only reads the file index and a few small files, so a 300 MB map is fine.

      1. Choose the ZIP

      No file chosen

      3. Report

      The report is split into short parts so nothing gets cut off. Copy each part and paste it into the chat, in order.

      FS vehicle inspector

      Checks a vehicle mod ZIP (FS22, FS25 or converted) right on your phone. Nothing is uploaded. It looks for missing wheel files, wrong upper/lower case in names, missing model files, custom shaders and more. Then you paste the short report into the chat.

      1. Choose the ZIP

      FS map compare

      Compares the original PC map with its mobile version and shows what was changed. It runs on your phone, uploads nothing, and only reads the file lists and a few small files, so large maps are fine.

      1. Choose the two ZIP files

      FS game files check

      Learns which files exist in the FS26 mobile game, then checks your mod or map against that list and tells you which game files it uses that the mobile game does not have. It runs on your phone and uploads nothing. It changes nothing.

      1. Choose the game APK (once)

      FS app scanner

      Reads the game APK on your phone and lists the real shop categories, vehicle types and building types. It only reads names. Nothing is uploaded and nothing in the game is changed. A 3 GB file is fine.
